title: Tunanin baya
description: Ten short stories about memories in Hausaland: a grandmother's first Ramadan fast in Katsina, the night of a fuel tanker explosion that made a boy a doctor, an old plane ticket from a first Hajj, a ride in a father's lorry, a school literature magazine in Sokoto, a schools football final heard on the radio, a woman's campaign for women's votes in 1999, a visit to Gidan Makama, a nurse's vaccination days in Kano and a son's promise to rebuild a mosque in Borno.

lessons.title: Azumin farko na Zinatu
lessons.summary: Old Zinatu tells her granddaughter about her first fast in Katsina: drummers woke the town before dawn, she swept and polished all day to forget her hunger, carried a basket of food to a lonely neighbour, and her father slaughtered a chicken for her.
lessons.text:
Kausar yarinya ce mai shekara goma. A wannan shekara za ta yi azumi na farko a rayuwarta. Da yamma, ta zauna kusa da kakarta, Hajiya Zinatu.

"Kaka, yaya azuminki na farko ya kasance?" Kausar ta tambaya.

Hajiya Zinatu ta yi murmushi. "Ina tunawa kamar jiya," ta ce. "Ina da shekara goma, kamar ke. Muna zaune a Katsina a lokacin. Ubana, Malam Shafi'u, malamin addini ne."

"A wancan lokacin babu agogo a gidanmu. Saboda haka ba mu san lokaci sosai ba. Da dare, wasu matasa sukan zagaya gari suna buga ganga domin su tashe mutane su ci abinci kafin gari ya waye. Idan na ji ƙarar ganga, na san cewa lokacin cin abinci ya yi."

"A ranar farko, da na ji ganga, na tashi da sauri. Ubana ya ce mini, 'Zinatu, ki ci abinci sosai, domin rana tana da tsawo.' Mahaifiyata ta ciyar da mu da abinci mai kyau."

"Da safe, mahaifiyata ta ce in share gida. Na share ko'ina, sannan na goge takalman ubana, na goge kofuna duka. Na rinƙa aiki domin kada in tuna da yunwa. Amma da rana ta yi zafi, sai yunwa ta kama ni."

"Ubana ya gan ni ina kuka. Ya ce, 'Idan ba za ki iya ba, ki ci abinci.' Amma na ce masa ba zan ci ba. Ya ce in je in kwanta a ɗaki. Na rinƙa kallon ƙofa ina jiran yamma."

"Da yamma, mahaifiyata ta ba ni wani kwando. Ta ce in kai wannan kwando gidan wata tsohuwa a unguwarmu, wadda ba ta da kowa. A cikin kwandon akwai abinci da 'ya'yan itace. Mahaifiyata takan ciyar da wannan tsohuwa kowace rana a watan azumi. Ta ce, 'Ciyar da mai yunwa abu ne mai kyau a watan azumi.'"

"Da rana ta faɗi, ubana ya yanka kaza saboda azumina na farko. Ya ce, 'Na yanka wannan kaza saboda ke, Zinatu.' Ban taɓa jin daɗin abinci kamar wannan ba. Kowa a gida ya rinƙa yi mini murna."

Kausar ta ce, "Kaka, ni ma zan iya!"

"Za ki iya," Hajiya Zinatu ta ce. "Yanzu kowa yana da agogo a wayarsa, kuma ba a buga ganga sosai. Amma idan kika ji agogonki da dare, kada ki ci gaba da barci."

Tambayoyi:
Hajiya Zinatu tana da shekara nawa a lokacin azuminta na farko?
Tana da shekara goma a lokacin azuminta na farko.
Me ya sa matasa suke buga ganga da dare?
Suna buga ganga domin su tashe mutane su ci abinci, saboda babu agogo a gidaje.
Me Zinatu ta yi da safe?
Ta share gida, ta goge takalman ubanta da kofuna.
Me ke cikin kwandon?
Akwai abinci da 'ya'yan itace a cikin kwandon.
Me ubanta ya yi da rana ta faɗi?
Ya yanka kaza saboda azuminta na farko.

lessons.title: Daren da na zaɓi likitanci
lessons.summary: The doctor Rilwanu remembers the night a fuel tanker exploded near his home when he was fifteen; he carried a burnt boy who was still breathing to hospital, watched the nurses care for him, and chose to study medicine.
lessons.text:
Sunana Rilwanu. Yanzu ni likita ne a wani babban asibiti a Kano. Mutane sukan tambaye ni me ya sa na zaɓi aikin likitanci. Amsata kullum ɗaya ce: daren fashewar motar fetur.

A wancan lokacin ina da shekara 15. Muna zaune a wani gari kusa da babbar hanya. Wata rana da dare, wata babbar mota da take ɗauke da fetur ta faɗi a kan hanya. Fetur ya zube a ƙasa. Mutane da yawa suka je wurin domin su ɗauki fetur kyauta.

Mahaifina ya hana ni zuwa. Ya ce mini, "Fetur yana da haɗari. Idan wuta ta kama shi, za a yi fashewa." Bayan minti goma, sai muka ji wata babbar fashewa. Fashewar ta girgiza gidanmu duka. Har yanzu, idan na ji ƙara mai ƙarfi, sai jikina ya girgiza.

Na fita waje tare da mahaifina. Wuta tana ci a kan hanya. Mutane suna gudu, suna kuka. Na ga wani yaro kwance a ƙasa. Ba ya motsi, amma na sa kunnena kusa da bakinsa, na ji yana numfashi. Na ji tausayinsa sosai. Muka ɗauke shi, muka kai shi asibiti.

A asibitin, likitoci da ma'aikatan jinya sun yi aiki har safe. Wani likita ya duba numfashin yaron, ya ce, "Yana raye. Kun kawo shi da wuri." Ban taɓa mantawa da wannan magana ba.

Da safe, rediyo ya ruwaito cewa mutane fiye da 60 sun mutu. Amma rediyon ya kuma ruwaito cewa mutane da yawa suna raye saboda aikin likitoci da ma'aikatan jinya.

Yaron da muka ɗauka ya yi wata biyu yana jinya a asibiti. Na rinƙa zuwa ganinsa. Ina ganin yadda ma'aikatan jinya suke kula da shi, kuma ina jin tausayin dukan marasa lafiya. Na ce wa mahaifina, "Ina so in zama likita."

Bayan shekara uku, na shiga jami'a domin karatun likitanci. A can, wani farfesa ya koya mana yadda ake taimaka wa mutanen da wuta ta kama. Farfesan ya ce, "Likita yana buƙatar ilimi, amma kuma yana buƙatar tausayi. Idan ba ka da tausayi, ba za ka zama likita mai kyau ba."

Yanzu ni ma ina koyar da ɗalibai karatun likitanci. Na faɗa musu maganar farfesan nan. Duk lokacin da aka ruwaito labarin fashewar motar fetur, sai in tuna da wannan dare.

Tambayoyi:
Me fashewar ta yi wa gidansu?
Fashewar ta girgiza gidansu duka.
Me ya sa mahaifin Rilwanu ya hana shi zuwa?
Saboda fetur yana da haɗari, kuma idan wuta ta kama shi, za a yi fashewa.
Me likitan ya ce game da yaron?
Ya ce, "Yana raye. Kun kawo shi da wuri."
Wata nawa yaron ya yi yana jinya?
Ya yi wata biyu yana jinya a asibiti.
Me farfesan ya ce likita yake buƙata?
Ya ce likita yana buƙatar ilimi da tausayi.

lessons.title: Tikitin Alhaji Sirajo
lessons.summary: Hassana finds an old plane ticket in her grandfather's bag; Alhaji Sirajo tells how he saved for twelve years, flew with a European pilot from Africa to Asia, waited at immigration in Jeddah and wept at the Kaaba in Mecca.
lessons.text:
Alhaji Sirajo yana da shekara 80. Wata rana, Hassana, 'yar ɗansa, ta ga wani tsohon tikiti a cikin wata tsohuwar jaka a ɗakinsa.

"Kaka, wannan tikitin me ne?" ta tambaya.

Alhaji Sirajo ya ɗauki tikitin, ya yi murmushi. "Wannan tikitin jirgin sama ne," ya ce. "Na saye shi lokacin da na je Hajji karo na farko."

Ya ba ta labari. "A lokacin ni manomi ne a wani ƙauye kusa da Zaria. Ba ni da kuɗi da yawa. Na soma tanadi tun ina saurayi. Kowace shekara, bayan an tattara amfanin gona, nakan ajiye wani ɓangare na kuɗina. Tanadin ya ɗauki shekara goma sha biyu kafin ya isa sayen tikiti."

"Da na sayi tikitin, sai na sa shi a cikin wannan jaka. Ban taɓa barin jakar ba. Da dare ina kwana da jakar kusa da kaina."

"Ranar tafiya, muka shiga jirgi a Kano. Ban taɓa shiga jirgin sama ba. Da jirgin ya tashi, na duba ta taga, na ga mun yi sama sosai. Muna cikin samaniya! Na ji tsoro, amma kuma na ji daɗi."

"Wanda yake tuƙin jirgin bature ne. Shi ne bature na farko da na gani. Ya yi magana da yarensa, wani mutum kuma ya fassara mana da Hausa. Ya ce za mu bar nahiyar Afirka, mu shiga nahiyar Asiya. Ban taɓa barin nahiyarmu ba kafin wannan tafiya."

"Bayan awa biyar, jirgin ya soma sauka. Saukar jirgin ta girgiza mu kaɗan, amma mun sauka lafiya a Jidda."

"Bayan saukar jirgin, jami'an shige da fice suka duba takardunmu. Layin shige da fice yana da tsawo sosai. Muka jira awa uku. Wani jami'in shige da fice ya tambaye ni sunana, ya duba tikitina, sannan muka fita."

"Daga nan muka tafi Makka, birni mai tsarki. Lokacin da na ga Ka'aba, na yi kuka saboda farin ciki. Na ji tsarkin wurin a cikin zuciyata."

"Kaka, me ya sa ka ajiye tikitin har yau?" Hassana ta ce.

"Domin yana tuna mini cewa idan mutum ya soma tanadi da wuri, zai iya cika burinsa," ya ce. "Har yanzu, idan na ga jirgi a samaniya, sai in tuna da wannan tafiya. Ke ma ki soma tanadi yanzu."

Tambayoyi:
Me Hassana ta gani a cikin tsohuwar jaka?
Ta ga wani tsohon tikitin jirgin sama.
Shekara nawa tanadin Alhaji Sirajo ya ɗauka?
Tanadin ya ɗauki shekara goma sha biyu.
Wane ne yake tuƙin jirgin?
Wani bature ne yake tuƙin jirgin.
Me Alhaji Sirajo ya gani a samaniya?
Ya ga sun yi sama sosai, sai ya ce, "Muna cikin samaniya!"
Me ya faru lokacin saukar jirgin?
Saukar jirgin ta girgiza su kaɗan, amma sun sauka lafiya a Jidda.
Me ya sa Alhaji Sirajo ya ajiye tikitin?
Domin yana tuna masa cewa idan mutum ya soma tanadi da wuri, zai iya cika burinsa.

lessons.title: Motar mahaifina
lessons.summary: Uwaisu remembers riding in his father's lorry, which carried rice under a contract; on a bad road the lorry broke down on a hill, another driver brought a part, and his father taught him that wealth needs work.
lessons.text:
Sunana Uwaisu. Lokacin da nake yaro a Kano, mahaifina, Malam Danliti, yana tuƙa babbar mota. Motarsa tana ɗaukar shinkafa daga ƙauyuka zuwa birni. Mahaifina yakan ce shinkafa tana ɗaya daga cikin manyan albarkatun ƙasarmu. Manoma da yawa sun sami wadata saboda ita.

Mahaifina yana da kwangila da wani kamfani. A cikin kwangilar, kamfanin ya ce zai biya shi kuɗi a kan kowace tafiya. Kwangilar ta ba shi aiki mai yawa. Saboda haka yana tuƙa motar tun safe har dare.

Wata rana a lokacin hutun makaranta, ya ɗauke ni tare da shi. Na zauna a gefensa a cikin motar. Na ji daɗi sosai. Ya ba ni gargaɗi kafin mu tafi: "Kada ka fita daga mota ba tare da izinina ba. Wannan ne gargaɗina."

Hanyar ƙauyen tana da muni. Akwai ramuka da yawa a cikinta. A kan hanyar akwai wani babban tudu. Da muka hau tudun, sai motar ta lalace. Injin ya mutu, motar ta tsaya.

Mahaifina ya fita ya duba injin. Ya ce, "Munin hanyar nan ne ya sa motar ta lalace." Madadin ya yi fushi, sai ya fara gyaran motar. Ni kuma na zauna a cikin mota, domin na tuna da gargaɗinsa. Rana tana da zafi sosai.

Bayan awa biyu, wani direba ya zo daga ƙauyen. Ya ba mahaifina wani ɓangaren inji madadin wanda ya lalace. Mahaifina ya gyara motar, muka ci gaba da tafiya.

Da muka isa ƙauyen, manoma sun riga sun tattara shinkafarsu. Muka ɗauki kayan, muka koma Kano da dare. A kan tudun, mahaifina ya yi tafiya a hankali sosai.

A hanyar dawowa, mahaifina ya ce mini, "Uwaisu, albarkatun ƙasa sun ba manoman nan wadata. Amma wadata tana buƙatar aiki. Madadin ka zauna kana jiran kuɗi, ka tashi ka yi aiki."

Yanzu ni ma ina tuƙa mota, amma ba babbar mota ba. Duk lokacin da na ga wani babban tudu, sai in tuna da ranar da motar mahaifina ta lalace, da gargaɗinsa, da maganarsa game da wadata.

Tambayoyi:
Me motar Malam Danliti take ɗauka?
Tana ɗaukar shinkafa daga ƙauyuka zuwa birni.
Wane gargaɗi mahaifinsa ya ba shi?
Ya ce kada ya fita daga mota ba tare da izininsa ba.
Me ya sa motar ta lalace?
Ta lalace saboda munin hanyar.
Me direban ya ba mahaifinsa?
Ya ba shi wani ɓangaren inji madadin wanda ya lalace.
Me mahaifinsa ya ce game da wadata?
Ya ce albarkatun ƙasa sun ba manoma wadata, amma wadata tana buƙatar aiki.

lessons.title: Mujallar makarantarmu
lessons.summary: The professor Zayyanu finds the literature magazine he and his friend Furera made at school in Sokoto; classmates laughed at it and called him a fool, but the second issue won praise from parents on display day.
lessons.text:
Malam Zayyanu malamin adabi ne a wata jami'a a Sokoto. Wata rana yana gyaran ɗakin littattafansa, sai ya ga wata tsohuwar mujalla. Mujallar makarantar sakandarensu ce, daga shekarar 1988.

Ya zauna, ya buɗe mujallar. Nan take ya tuna da lokacin ƙirƙirar wannan mujalla.

A lokacin, Zayyanu yana aji na huɗu. Shi da abokiyarsa Furera suna son adabi sosai. Suna karanta nau'ikan littattafai: labarai, waƙoƙi da wasan kwaikwayo. Wata rana Furera ta ce, "Me zai hana mu soma ƙirƙirar mujallar adabi ta makarantarmu?"

Suka je wurin shugaban makaranta. Ya ce, "Kuna da shawara mai kyau. Amma kada ku rubuta maganganun banza. Mujallar ta zama ta ilimi."

Ƙirƙirar mujallar ba ta yi sauƙi ba. Suka tattara nau'ikan rubutu daga ɗalibai: labarai, waƙoƙi da wasiƙu. Zayyanu ya rubuta sharhi a kan wani shahararren littafin adabi na Hausa. Furera ta rubuta waƙa.

Da mujallar ta fito, wasu ɗalibai suka yi dariya. Wani yaro ya ce, "Wannan mujalla ta banza ce. Wa zai karanta sharhi a kan littafi? Sai wawa!" Wasu kuma suka ce Zayyanu wawa ne.

Zayyanu ya yi baƙin ciki. Amma Furera ta ce, "Kada ka damu. Waɗancan ɗalibai ba su san amfanin adabi ba. Martanin da ya fi kyau shi ne mu ci gaba da aiki." Saboda haka ba su ba waɗancan ɗalibai martani da magana ba. Madadin haka, suka shirya mujalla ta biyu mafi kyau.

A ƙarshen shekara, makarantar ta yi ranar nunawa. A ranar nunawa, ɗalibai suna nuna wa iyaye abin da suka yi a shekarar. Zayyanu da Furera suka ajiye mujallarsu a kan teburi. Iyaye da yawa sun karanta ta, sun yaba mata. Mujallar ta sami martani mai kyau daga kowa. Har waɗancan ɗaliban da suka yi dariya a da sun zo wurin teburin.

Yanzu, shekara 35 bayan haka, Zayyanu farfesa ne a fannin adabi, Furera kuma tana aiki a wata babbar mujalla a Kano. Zayyanu ya kira ta. "Na sami mujallarmu ta farko," ya ce. "Kina tuna lokacin da aka ce ni wawa ne?"

Furera ta yi dariya. "Ina tunawa," ta ce. "Amma ka ga, mujallar ba ta banza ba ce."

Tambayoyi:
Me Zayyanu ya gani a ɗakin littattafansa?
Ya ga wata tsohuwar mujallar makarantar sakandarensu.
Wane irin littattafai Zayyanu da Furera suke so?
Suna son nau'ikan littattafai: labarai, waƙoƙi da wasan kwaikwayo.
Me Zayyanu ya rubuta a mujallar farko?
Ya rubuta sharhi a kan wani shahararren littafin adabi na Hausa.
Me wani yaro ya ce game da mujallar?
Ya ce mujallar ta banza ce, kuma sai wawa zai karanta sharhi.
Wane martani Furera ta ce ya fi kyau?
Ta ce martanin da ya fi kyau shi ne su ci gaba da aiki.
Me iyaye suka yi a ranar nunawa?
Sun karanta mujallar, sun yaba mata.

lessons.title: Wasan ƙarshe
lessons.summary: Hadi remembers the schools football final in Kano: his coach taught them the rules, they came back from two goals down to win three to two, and his grandmother, who listened on the radio, jumped for joy.
lessons.text:
Hadi yana da shekara 50 yanzu, amma ba zai manta da ranar wasan ƙarshe na makarantarsu ba har abada.

A wancan lokacin yana da shekara 14, kuma yana buga ƙwallon ƙafa a ƙungiyar makarantarsu a Kano. Ƙwallo yana ba shi nishaɗi sosai. Malam Lawwali ne yake horar da su. Kowace yamma yakan horar da yaran a filin makaranta. Ya koya musu ka'idojin wasan. "Kada ku taɓa ƙwallo da hannu, kuma kada ku tura 'yan wasan ɗaya ƙungiyar," ya ce. "Idan ba ku bi ka'idoji ba, alƙalin wasa zai fitar da ku."

Ƙungiyarsu ta kai wasan ƙarshe na gasar makarantun jihar. Za a yi wasan a babban filin wasa na birni. Ranar wasan, magoya bayan makarantar sun cika filin. Hatta malamai da iyaye sun zo. Hatta shugaban makaranta, wanda ba ya son ƙwallo, ya zo.

Magoya baya sun rinƙa waƙa da ihu. Amma a rabin farko, ɗaya ƙungiyar ta ci ƙwallaye biyu. Hadi da abokansa sun yi baƙin ciki. Malam Lawwali ya ce musu, "Ku tuna da horon da na yi muku. Ku bi ka'idoji, ku yi wasa tare."

A rabin na biyu, Hadi ya ci ƙwallo ɗaya. Sai abokinsa ya ci na biyu. Kafin a tashi, Hadi ya sake cin ƙwallo. Sun ci ƙwallaye uku, ɗaya ƙungiyar ta ci biyu. Magoya bayan makarantar suka shiga filin suna murna.

Kakar Hadi ba ta iya zuwa filin ba, saboda ƙafarta tana ciwo. Amma hatta ita ta kunna rediyo a gida, ta saurari wasan duka. Wani mai sharhi a rediyo ya rinƙa faɗin sunan Hadi.

Da Hadi ya dawo gida, kakarsa ta ce, "Na saurari wasan tun farko har ƙarshe. Da na ji cewa Hadi ya ci ƙwallaye biyu, na yi tsalle!"

Hadi ya yi dariya. "Kaka, ban taɓa jin nishaɗi kamar na yau ba," ya ce. "Ba zan manta da yau ba har abada." Kakarsa ta ce, "Ni ma. Wasan ya ba kowa a unguwarmu nishaɗi."

Yanzu Hadi yana horar da yara a unguwarsu. Yana koya musu ka'idojin wasa kamar yadda Malam Lawwali ya koya masa. Idan ya kunna rediyo ya saurari labarin wasan ƙwallo, sai ya tuna da kakarsa, wadda ta yi tsalle saboda ƙwallayensa. Ba zai manta da ita ba har abada.

Tambayoyi:
Wane ne yake horar da ƙungiyar makarantar?
Malam Lawwali ne yake horar da su.
Me Malam Lawwali ya ce game da ka'idoji?
Ya ce idan ba su bi ka'idoji ba, alƙalin wasa zai fitar da su.
Ƙwallaye nawa ƙungiyar Hadi ta ci?
Sun ci ƙwallaye uku, ɗaya ƙungiyar ta ci biyu.
Yaya kakar Hadi ta saurari wasan?
Ta kunna rediyo a gida, ta saurari wasan duka.
Me Hadi yake yi yanzu?
Yana horar da yara a unguwarsu.

lessons.title: Zaɓen da ba zan manta ba
lessons.summary: Murjanatu remembers the 1999 election in Kano: her brother was a party secretary, she went from house to house against the discrimination of women voters, voting was cancelled at one place, and their good candidate won.
lessons.text:
Hajiya Murjanatu tana da shekara 57 yanzu. Amma tana tunawa da zaɓen shekarar 1999 kamar jiya. A wannan shekara, mutanen Najeriya sun zaɓi shugabanninsu bayan shekaru da yawa na mulkin soja.

A lokacin, ɗan uwanta, Malam Abdulwahab, shi ne sakataren wata jam'iyya a mazaɓarsu a Kano. A matsayinsa na sakataren jam'iyya, yana zuwa taro kowace rana.

Murjanatu kuma ta yi fafutuka domin mata su yi zaɓe. A wancan lokacin, ana nuna wa mata wariya a wasu wurare. Wasu maza suna cewa mata ba sa buƙatar zuwa wurin zaɓe. Murjanatu ta ce wannan wariya ba daidai ba ce. Ta rinƙa zuwa gida gida, tana gaya wa mata cewa ƙuri'arsu tana da muhimmanci.

Kafin zaɓe, mutane sun yi hasashe da yawa. Wasu sun yi hasashen cewa jam'iyyar Abdulwahab za ta ci, wasu kuma sun ce ba za ta ci ba. Kakakin jam'iyyar ya yi magana a rediyo. Ya ce, "Muna da ɗan takara nagari. Mutum ne mai gaskiya, kuma yana son talakawa."

Ranar zaɓe, mata da yawa sun fito a mazaɓar. Suna tsaye a layi tun da safe. Amma da rana, sai aka ji labari cewa an soke zaɓe a wani wuri a cikin mazaɓar, saboda wasu matasa sun yi faɗa. Murjanatu ta ji tsoron cewa za a soke zaɓen gaba ɗaya. Amma kakakin hukumar zaɓe ya ce ba za a soke shi ba. Za a sake yin zaɓe a wannan wuri kawai.

Bayan kwana biyu, aka faɗi sakamako. Ɗan takarar jam'iyyar Abdulwahab ya ci. Hasashen wasu mutane ya zama gaskiya, na wasu kuma bai zama gaskiya ba.

Abdulwahab ya ce wa Murjanatu, "Fafutukarki ce ta kawo sauyi a mazaɓarmu. Mata da yawa sun yi zaɓe saboda ke."

Yanzu, idan zaɓe ya zo, Murjanatu takan ba 'yan matan unguwarsu labarin wannan lokaci. "Sauyi ba ya zuwa da sauƙi," takan ce. "Sai an yi fafutuka. Kuma idan kun je zaɓe, ku zaɓi mutum nagari, ba mai kuɗi kawai ba."

Tambayoyi:
Wane aiki Malam Abdulwahab yake yi a jam'iyyarsu?
Shi ne sakataren jam'iyyar a mazaɓarsu.
Me ya sa Murjanatu ta yi fafutuka?
Ta yi fafutuka domin mata su yi zaɓe, saboda ana nuna musu wariya.
Me kakakin jam'iyyar ya ce a rediyo?
Ya ce suna da ɗan takara nagari, mai gaskiya.
Me ya sa aka soke zaɓe a wani wuri?
Saboda wasu matasa sun yi faɗa a wurin.
Me Abdulwahab ya ce wa Murjanatu?
Ya ce fafutukarta ce ta kawo sauyi a mazaɓarsu.

lessons.title: A Gidan Makama
lessons.summary: Alhaji Mahe takes his grandson Fahad to the Gidan Makama museum, tells him how he grew up in the emir's palace in his uncle's care, and shows him old weapons, a photo of the rebellion against the British and an old prison room.
lessons.text:
Wata rana, Alhaji Mahe ya kai ɗan ɗansa, Fahad, Gidan Makama a Kano. Tsohon gida ne kusa da fadar Sarkin Kano. Yanzu gidan tarihi ne, kuma ana yin nuni na tsofaffin kayayyakin Kano a cikinsa.

Da suka shiga, Alhaji Mahe ya ce, "Fahad, lokacin da nake yaro, na yi zama a cikin fada. Mahaifina ya rasu ina ƙarami, sai ɗan uwan mahaifina, wanda yake aiki a fada, ya karɓi riƙona. Na yi shekara takwas a ƙarƙashin riƙonsa."

"Yaya rayuwa take a fada?" Fahad ya tambaya.

"Muna tashi da wuri, muna share ƙofar fada, muna koyon karatu," kakansa ya ce.

A cikin nunin, akwai makamai da yawa. Wasu makamai suna rataye a bango: garkuwoyi da tsofaffin bindigogi. Kowane makami yana da labarinsa. Nunin yana da ɗakuna da yawa. Fahad ya ce, "Kaka, na ga irin waɗannan makamai a cikin finafinan tarihi a talabijin!"

"Haka ne," kakansa ya ce. "Amma waɗannan makamai ba na finafinan ba ne. Mutanen Kano na da ne suka yi amfani da su." Ya nuna wata tsohuwar bindiga. "Wannan makamin na wani babban jarumi ne."

Fahad ya ce, "Kaka, wane makami ka fi so?"

"Wannan bindiga," kakansa ya ce.

Alhaji Mahe ya nuna masa wani tsohon hoto da yake rataye a bango. "Wannan hoton yana nuna fadar a lokacin da Turawa suka zo," ya ce. "Wasu mutane sun yi tawaye ga Turawa. Amma tawayen bai yi nasara ba, saboda makamai na mutanen Kano ba su da ƙarfi kamar bindigogin Turawa."

A wani ɗaki, wani ma'aikacin gidan tarihin ya ce musu, "A da, ana amfani da wannan ɗaki a matsayin kaso. Ana ajiye ɓarayi a cikin kaso har sai alƙali ya yanke hukunci."

Kafin su fita, Fahad ya ga wasu tsofaffin riguna da aka rataya a jikin bango. Ma'aikacin ya ce, "Waɗannan rigunan sun yi shekara ɗari. Mun kula da su domin al'adunmu su sami ɗorewa."

Alhaji Mahe ya ce, "Gaskiya ne. Al'adunmu suna da ɗorewa saboda mutane suna kula da su. Idan ba a kula da su ba, ba za su sami ɗorewa ba."

Da suka fita, Fahad ya ce, "Kaka, wata rana ka sake kawo ni nan. Kuma ka ba ni ƙarin labarin rayuwarka a fada."

Tambayoyi:
Ina gidan tarihin yake?
Gidan tarihin yana kusa da fadar Sarkin Kano.
Wane ne ya karɓi riƙon Alhaji Mahe?
Ɗan uwan mahaifinsa, wanda yake aiki a fada, ya karɓi riƙonsa.
Ina Fahad ya ga irin waɗannan makamai a da?
Ya gan su a cikin finafinan tarihi a talabijin.
Me ya sa tawayen bai yi nasara ba?
Saboda makamai na mutanen Kano ba su da ƙarfi kamar bindigogin Turawa.
Me ake yi a ɗakin kaso a da?
Ana ajiye ɓarayi a cikin kaso har sai alƙali ya yanke hukunci.

lessons.title: Ranakun rigakafi
lessons.summary: The nurse Shamsiyya tells a journalist about a children's vaccination campaign in Kano: parents did not trust the medicine, the director took three measures, a religious teacher vaccinated his children in public, and an angry father came back.
lessons.text:
Shamsiyya ma'aikaciyar jinya ce a Kano. Ta yi shekara 30 tana aiki. Wata rana wani ɗan jarida ya tambaye ta, "Wane aiki ne ba za ki manta da shi ba?"

Ta ce, "Aikin rigakafin yara da muka yi shekaru da yawa da suka wuce. Ina tunawa da shi sosai."

"A lokacin, mutane da yawa ba su da aminci da maganin rigakafi. Wasu suna cewa maganin yana da illa. Saboda haka iyaye da yawa ba sa barin a ba 'ya'yansu."

"Daraktan lafiya na jihar ya ba mu umurni mu je gida gida. Umurninsa shi ne mu yi magana da iyaye a hankali, kuma kada mu tilasta wa kowa."

"A rana ta farko, wasu iyaye sun kawo ƙorafi. Wani mutum ya ce mini, 'Ni ba na son ku zo gidana. Ina da ƙorafi game da wannan magani.' Na ji ɓacin rai, amma ban yi fushi ba. Na ce masa, 'Sannu, Malam. Mun ji ƙorafinka. Za mu dawo wata rana.'"

"Da yamma, na faɗa wa darakta ƙorafin iyayen. Daraktan ya ɗauki matakai uku. Na farko, ya kira malaman addini da masu unguwanni, ya bayyana musu amfanin rigakafi. Na biyu, ya sa aka yi magana a rediyo da Hausa. Na uku, ya ce a ba kowane yaro da aka yi wa rigakafi kyauta."

"Waɗannan matakai sun yi amfani. Wani malamin addini ya kawo 'ya'yansa, aka yi musu rigakafi a gaban jama'a. Da mutane suka ga haka, sai aminci ya soma dawowa."

"Bayan mako ɗaya, wannan mutumin da ya kawo ƙorafi ya zo asibitinmu da 'ya'yansa uku. Ya ce, 'Sannu da aiki. Na zo don a yi wa 'ya'yana rigakafi.' Ɓacin raina ya tafi, na yi murna sosai."

"Ka ga, aminci ba ya zuwa da sauri. Idan mutane ba su da aminci da kai, ba za su saurari maganarka ba. Amma idan ka yi haƙuri, ka ɗauki matakai na gaskiya, za su saurari maganarka."

Ɗan jaridar ya ce, "Na gode, Hajiya. Sannu da aiki."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa iyaye da yawa ba sa barin a ba 'ya'yansu rigakafi?
Saboda ba su da aminci da maganin, wasu suna cewa yana da illa.
Wane umurni darakta ya ba ma'aikatan jinya?
Ya ce su je gida gida, su yi magana da iyaye a hankali.
Me Shamsiyya ta ce wa mutumin da ya kawo ƙorafi?
Ta ce, "Sannu, Malam. Mun ji ƙorafinka."
Matakai nawa daraktan ya ɗauka?
Ya ɗauki matakai uku.
Me ya sa ɓacin ran Shamsiyya ya tafi?
Saboda mutumin ya kawo 'ya'yansa uku domin a yi musu rigakafi.

lessons.title: Wa'adin da na yi wa mahaifina
lessons.summary: Kyari's father Modu had to leave his village near Konduga in Borno after terrorists destroyed its mosque; in his old age in Kano he made his son promise to rebuild it, and after his death Kyari keeps the promise.
lessons.text:
Sunana Kyari. Mahaifina, Modu, ya rayu shekara 82. Ya rayu mafi yawan rayuwarsa a wani ƙauye kusa da Konduga, a jihar Borno. A can ya yi noma, ya yi aure, kuma a can aka haife ni.

Wata shekara, 'yan ta'adda sun kawo hari a ƙauyenmu. Sun rushe masallaci da makaranta, kuma sun rushe gidaje da yawa. Ba a kashe kowa a gidanmu ba, amma dole mu yi ƙaura. Muka yi ƙaura zuwa Kano, inda ɗan uwan mahaifina yake zaune.

Mahaifina bai so ya rabu da ƙauyensa ba. Ranar da muka rabu da ƙauyen, ya yi kuka. Ya ce, "Na rayu a nan tun ina yaro. Yaya zan rabu da shi?"

A Kano, ya rinƙa tambayar labarin ƙauyen kowace rana. Idan wani ya zo daga Borno, sai ya tambaye shi ko 'yan ta'adda sun bar wurin.

Da tsufa ya kama shi, ba ya iya tafiya da nisa. Tsufa ya sa ya rasa ƙarfinsa. Wata rana ya faɗi a gida, ƙashin ƙafarsa ya samu rauni. Likitoci sun ce ƙasusuwan mutum masu tsufa ba sa warkewa da sauri. Ya yi wata uku yana kwance.

Wata rana ya kira ni. Ya ce, "Ɗana, ka yi mini wa'adi. Idan 'yan ta'adda sun bar ƙauyenmu, ka koma ka sake gina masallacin da suka rushe. Ɗana, kuma ka kula da mahaifiyarka."

Na ce, "Baba, na yi maka wa'adi."

Bayan wata biyu, mahaifina ya rasu. Rasuwarsa ta kawo mana baƙin ciki sosai. Mutane da yawa sun zo gidanmu bayan rasuwarsa. Kowa ya ce mahaifina mutumin kirki ne.

Shekara uku bayan rasuwarsa, aka sami zaman lafiya a yankin. 'Yan ta'adda sun bar wurin. Mutanen da suka yi ƙaura sun soma dawowa. Na koma ƙauyen. Gidajen da aka rushe suna nan yadda suke, amma mutane sun fara gyaran su.

Na tattara kuɗi tare da sauran mutanen ƙauyen, muka sake gina masallacin. Ranar da aka buɗe masallacin, na tuna da maganar mahaifina: "Ɗana, ka yi mini wa'adi." Yau na cika wa'adina.

Tambayoyi:
Shekara nawa Modu ya rayu?
Ya rayu shekara 82.
Me ya sa iyalin Kyari suka yi ƙaura zuwa Kano?
Saboda 'yan ta'adda sun kawo hari a ƙauyensu, sun rushe gidaje da masallaci.
Me ya faru da ƙashin ƙafar Modu?
Ya faɗi a gida, ƙashin ƙafarsa ya samu rauni.
Wane wa'adi Kyari ya yi wa mahaifinsa?
Ya yi masa wa'adi cewa zai koma ya sake gina masallacin da aka rushe.
Me Kyari ya yi bayan rasuwar mahaifinsa?
Ya koma ƙauyen, ya sake gina masallacin tare da mutanen ƙauyen.
